s: Elasticsearch, Meilisearch, Typesense, full-text search, indexing
d: When SQL LIKE queries aren't enough, you need a search engine. Elasticsearch powers search at scale with full-text search, fuzzy matching, faceted filters, and autocomplete. Meilisearch and Typesense are simpler alternatives.
